V. 15.
Beware of falſe prophets—Who in their Preaching deſcribe a broad Way to Heaven: It is their propheſying, their teaching the broad Way, rather than their walking in it themſelves, that is
••re chiefly ſpoken of. All thoſe are falſe prophets, who teach any other Way than that our LORD hath here marked out. In ſheep's cloathing— With Outſide Religion and fair Profeſſions of Love: Wolves—Not feeding, but deſtroying Souls.
